issue.title: mission_raw   missionitem

comments.body: What's the error? Does it upload but not do the right thing? Can you debug it in SITL?

> What's the error? Does it upload but not do the right thing? Can you debug it in SITL?

The drone did not fly according to the designated GPS point
Does it fly somewhere else? Can you download the mission items using QGC to see if they are correct on the map?

> Does it fly somewhere else? Can you download the mission items using QGC to see if they are correct on the map?
Thank you. I have found the problem. The longitude and latitude need to be *10e7. I have another question, will mavsdk automatically convert 353632612 to 35.3632612?
